g.text: ten readings: different length, rate, pitch, pauses, breath — all correct
where does the decision “which reading” live in a TTS system? four places:
attention · a duration predictor · the AR stop symbol · given from outside
autoregression over W6's tokens, or a velocity field on continuous mel / latents
a vocoder (W2's phase, W6's discriminators), a codec decoder, or an iSTFT
4 how long does each decision delay the first packet?
three shapes of the first packet; W1's TTS cell gets its number
the variation question has only two answers — and the 2026 recipe uses one of each, on its own layer
